awakening.text: Three days up the pass, and the mountain has not once looked back at you.

awakening.speaker: mira
awakening.text: Right. Either that ridge moved, or I've been walking in a circle since noon.
Then the cloud parts — and something vast turns its head.

awakening.speaker: golem
awakening.text: You are small. And you are late.

awakening.speaker: golem
awakening.text: I have been counting winters since anyone last climbed this far. Six hundred and eleven. You are late by all of them.

introductions.speaker: golem
introductions.text: Speak, then. Travellers used to give a name before they gave demands.

options.text: Say nothing, and study the gears in his chest.

gave_name.speaker: mira
gave_name.text: Mira. And I'm not demanding anything — I'd just like to know what I'm looking at.
He says it slowly, the way you'd handle something you were afraid of dropping.

gave_name.speaker: golem
gave_name.text: Good. A name is a thing that can be given back later.

stayed_silent.text: You keep your mouth shut and your eyes on the machinery: a lattice of gold wheels, most of them still, one of them bent badly out of true.

stayed_silent.speaker: golem
stayed_silent.text: Careful. Staring is its own kind of demand.

stayed_silent.speaker: golem
stayed_silent.text: As you like. Silence keeps well up here. Everything does.

admitted_lost.speaker: mira
admitted_lost.text: I'm lost. I'll admit that much. The map stopped agreeing with the mountain somewhere around dawn.

admitted_lost.speaker: golem
admitted_lost.text: Maps rarely survive contact with this place. Honesty, though — that is rarer still.

admitted_lost.speaker: mira
admitted_lost.text: Don't make it into a virtue. I'm just tired.

the_offer.speaker: golem
the_offer.text: There is work in me that has gone unfinished for six hundred years. Gears that no longer turn. A name I can no longer pronounce.

the_offer.speaker: mira
the_offer.text: And you want me to what — reach in?

the_offer.speaker: golem
the_offer.text: Mend me, and I will carry you over the peaks by morning. Refuse, and I will let you pass. But you will walk, and the walking is long.

options.text: Reach for the seized gear in his chest.
"What happens to you if nobody ever does?"
Step back, and keep your hands to yourself.

the_question.speaker: mira
the_question.text: What happens to you if nobody ever does?
For a long moment the only sound is wind moving through him, the way it moves through a broken window.

the_question.speaker: golem
the_question.text: I keep counting. That is all. The counting does not stop when the turning does.

the_question.speaker: golem
the_question.text: You asked a horrible question. I thought it deserved the truth.

options.text: Reach for the seized gear after all.
Step back. This is not your repair to make.
"Tell me the name you can't pronounce. I'll carry it for you."

the_name.speaker: golem
the_name.text: You would carry it? It is heavy, and it is not a kind thing to know.

the_name.speaker: mira
the_name.text: I've carried worse up this mountain. Try me.
He tells her. It takes some time, and it is not a word in any language she has met.

the_name.speaker: golem
the_name.text: That is the whole thing. Six hundred years, and it took eleven seconds to hand over.

wander.speaker: mira
wander.text: Give me a minute. I don't decide things this size standing still.

wander.speaker: golem
wander.text: Well. You have had your minute, and rather more of them than that.

wander.speaker: mira
wander.text: It's a big mountain. Fine. Let's do this.

wander_saw_cairn.speaker: mira
wander_saw_cairn.text: Someone counted every winter you did. Six hundred and eleven marks, cut by hand, and then they stopped.

wander_saw_cairn.speaker: mira
wander_saw_cairn.text: You said nobody had climbed this far.

wander_saw_cairn.speaker: golem
wander_saw_cairn.text: Nobody had. They were already here.
He does not elaborate, and she decides — for now — not to make him.

pass_talk.speaker: mira
pass_talk.text: You said you'd carry me over. Do you actually know the way, or are we both guessing?

pass_talk.speaker: golem
pass_talk.text: I know every way. I have had six hundred years and nothing to walk them with.

pass_talk.speaker: golem
pass_talk.text: It is the closest thing to one you will get above the cloud line.

cairn_marks.text: Someone has cut a line of shallow marks into the top stone. Not letters. Tallies.
The last mark points down, over the edge, toward a ledge she had not noticed.

ledge_find.text: The marked stone comes away easily. Behind it, wrapped in oiled cloth, is a brass gear no bigger than her palm — and unmistakably the shape of the one seized in his chest.

ledge_find.speaker: mira
ledge_find.text: Someone left this here. For you. And then stopped coming.
It is the first time he has asked for anything.

give_gear.text: She holds it up. Small, filthy, and unmistakably his.

give_gear.speaker: mira
give_gear.text: Under a marked stone on the ledge. Wrapped, so it wouldn't corrode. Someone meant you to have it back.
He is quiet for long enough that she wonders whether she has broken something worse than a gear.

give_gear.speaker: golem
give_gear.text: Put it in. Please. I find I cannot ask twice.
It seats with a sound like a held breath let go.

mending.text: The bent wheel resists, complains, and finally gives. Something deep in the gold starts keeping time with her pulse.

mending.speaker: golem
mending.text: Ah. Warm hands. I had forgotten the shape of that.

mending.speaker: golem
mending.text: I have had a great deal of practice at counting. A name is easier.

refusal.speaker: mira
refusal.text: No. I don't know what I'd be starting, and neither do you.

refusal.speaker: golem
refusal.text: Wise. Cowardly, but wise. Not every hand that opens me means to close me again.

refusal.speaker: golem
refusal.text: Go, then. Stranger you came, stranger you leave. It is the usual arrangement.

refusal_named.speaker: golem
refusal_named.text: Go, then, Mira. I will keep the name. It costs me nothing to hold, and I have the room.

refusal_named.speaker: golem
refusal_named.text: No. But it is true, and you seemed to prefer those.

refusal_lost.speaker: golem
refusal_lost.text: Go, then. You said you were lost. Follow the water down — it is less honest than you are, but it knows the way.

ending_carried.text: He carries her over the peaks by morning, exactly as promised.
Neither of them says anything about the winters. Below the pass the map starts agreeing with the mountain again, which Mira decides not to mention.

ending_carried_name.text: She says the name once, near the summit, mostly to check that she still has it. The wind takes it and gives nothing back.
Below the pass she stops counting the winters he told her about, and starts counting the ones ahead. It is a better arithmetic, and it is his now as much as hers.

ending_walked.text: The cloud closes over him as she passes. She walks.
The walking is long, and she is alone with the sound of her own gears — and, for rather longer than she expects, with the arithmetic of six hundred and eleven winters.
